## Scope

Describe the narrowly bounded milestone and files changed.

## Component gitlink change

State whether any component gitlink changed. If so, include the old and new
SHA and the component repository/branch.

## Provenance

Record the source repository, branch lineage, and exact SHA for relevant
components.

## Tests

List exact commands and results. Do not label unrun VAEG or hardware work as a
pass.

## Private-artifact check

Confirm that no private manual, ROM, BIOS, disk image, secret, or
private-derived fact is included.
